info.desc: Singles Going Steady is a compilation album by Buzzcocks, released on September 25, 1979. It was their first album released in North America. Side one of the original release of the album featured their eight UK single releases on United Artists Records from 1977 up to the time of Singles Going Steady's release in 1979 in chronological order, while side two featured their corresponding B-sides, also in chronological order. .

podcast.body: Released in 1979, this album was a compilation of some previously released singles. It is considered a masterclass in how a band could effectively combine punk aggression with pop sensibilities. "This was a compilation of some previously released singles and it's a masterclass on how you can be punk and pop at the same time."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
